rendered: The electrochemically tested V2O5 films were the[1] ∼80 nm[2] film and the ∼40 nm[3] film (∼40 nm (see Supporting Information, Figure S14) V2O5 films[4]). The thicker film, the ∼80 nm[5] coating, was made with 1000 ALD cycles[6]. The potential shifts were essentially the same for the films: the strained states showed potential shifts of ∼40 mV[7], and similar shifts in values of ΔEeq(avg) were observed[8] for both films, owing to their similar locked-in elastic strains.
